boundaries: Bedside arithmetic forms only; diagnosis, treatment selection and monitoring protocols are excluded.
Records are algebraic forms for qualified clinical interpretation, never dosing recommendations; every record states its validated population scope.
Root forms (Mosteller/Boyd body-surface area, clearance inversions) must be deferred with sources, never approximated.
Patient parameters (weight, height, creatinine, age) are supplied inputs with stated units and population scope.
Expressions must be written in canonical base units of the runtime registry; never inline a conversion factor that belongs to unit scales (see the canonical-units rule).
coverage_guidance: Priorities are seeds, not a finite checklist. Continue into adjacent source chapters/subtopics inside the boundaries, selecting independently reusable relationships. Save multiple bounded batches without waiting for owner review. Check supplied inventory and prior returns for equivalent relationships and conflicting IDs. Record out-of-format discoveries as deferred with exact sources and missing capabilities; do not force chains or dilute quality for a quota.
integration_expectation: New meanings (body_mass_index, weight_based_dose, creatinine_clearance, infusion_rate, anion_gap and similar) and units (mg, mcg, mL, mmol/L, drops/mL and similar) require extension; all seed forms are scalar with integer powers and fit the engine once meanings exist.
mission: Curate atomic reusable algebraic clinical-arithmetic relationships: body-size indices, weight-based dosing arithmetic, renal estimates and infusion rates, each with explicit validated-population scope. Bedside arithmetic only; continue through successive batches with no inference chain required.
priorities: Body mass index from mass and height
Weight-based total dose from per-kilogram dose and body mass
Cockcroft-Gault creatinine clearance from age, mass, creatinine and sex factor
Gravity infusion drip rate from volume, drop factor and time
special_checks: Guard positive mass, height, creatinine and time; state the validated population (adult, non-pregnant and similar) in context
Keep unit-conversion literals (72 in Cockcroft-Gault, 10000 in BMI-if-cm and similar) explicit with stated unit convention
Test a boundary case (zero volume gives zero rate; extreme inputs rejected by guards, not clamped silently)
Distinguish the algebraic estimate from any therapeutic decision in assumptions and permitted use
starter_sources: https://openstax.org -- navigate to an anatomy/physiology or nursing-pharmacology title and its chapters on body measurements and dosage calculation; record exact book, edition and section, never cite the root as evidence
No further source URLs were preverified for this assignment; discovery snippets alone do not prove the equation
title: Clinical arithmetic: body indices, dosing and infusion rates
